prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on what you need. To help you pick, tell me a few things and I’ll give a tailored shortlist with pros/cons and next steps:

Quick questions
- What type of marketing do you need? (brand/creative, digital advertising, SEO, content, social, PR, B2B demand gen, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- What industry are you in and how big is your company?
- Do you want a local KC agency (onsite collaboration) or is remote OK?
- Are you looking for a long-term partner or a short-term project/ campaign?

A few pointers up front
- Large/full-service options in KC: VML and Barkley are two nationally recognized agencies headquartered in Kansas City known for big-brand work and end-to-end capabilities.
- Smaller/specialist shops can often deliver faster, more affordable, and more hands-on work for SMBs — choose them if you need focused expertise (SEO, paid media, social, creative) rather than a full-service partner.
- How to evaluate: ask for case studies with measurable results, client references, team you’ll work with, reporting cadence, and a clear scope + KPIs.

If you tell me the answers to the questions above, I’ll produce a short list of recommended KC agencies (large and boutique), with why each might fit and suggested interview questions. Which kinds of marketing and budget are you working with?
